concepts.label: Coordinate
concepts.definition: Position coordinate in an explicitly specified frame.
constraints: Positions are not additive extents.

concepts.label: Geodetic angular coordinate
concepts.definition: Angular position on a specified geodetic reference ellipsoid.

concepts.label: Geodetic latitude
concepts.definition: Angle between the ellipsoid normal and the equatorial plane; north positive.

concepts.label: Geodetic longitude
concepts.definition: Angular position eastward from the reference meridian.

concepts.label: Depth coordinate
concepts.definition: Depth position relative to an established reference, with a declared direction.
constraints: A quantity of length does not make depth positions summable.

concepts.label: Ellipsoidal depth
concepts.definition: Negative ellipsoidal height measured along the ellipsoid normal: positive inward from the reference ellipsoid.
constraints: Depth = -ellipsoidal height; not a geoid or mean-sea-level depth.

concepts.label: Geodetic position with ellipsoidal depth
concepts.definition: Position specified by geodetic latitude, longitude and ellipsoidal depth.

concepts.label: Total gravity vector
concepts.definition: Local acceleration vector including gravitational and centrifugal contributions.
constraints: Contains acceleration components; scalar gravity potential is a separate result, not a vector component.

concepts.label: Total gravity acceleration
concepts.definition: Component or magnitude of total gravity acceleration, including centrifugal acceleration.
constraints: Magnitude is nonnegative; signed components are not magnitudes.

concepts.label: Total gravity potential
concepts.definition: Total gravitational plus centrifugal potential returned by the gravity model.
constraints: Uses the geodetic sign convention: gravity is the gradient of total potential.
Includes gravitational and centrifugal contributions.
Meaningful precision of 0.01 m^2/s^2 is a display convention, not model accuracy.

concepts.label: Gravity evaluation request
concepts.definition: Request to evaluate gravity at supplied positions.

concepts.label: Gravity evaluation response
concepts.definition: Gravity evaluation samples with the model provenance used to calculate them.

concepts.label: Gravity sample
concepts.definition: An evaluated position paired with its gravity evaluation result, including total acceleration and scalar total potential.

concepts.label: Gravity model provenance
concepts.definition: Identity and reproducibility information for an installed gravity model.

concepts.label: Model name
concepts.definition: Human-readable name used to select a scientific model.

concepts.label: Model identifier
concepts.definition: Published model identifier; not necessarily a UUID.

concepts.label: Model publisher
concepts.definition: Organization publishing the scientific model.

concepts.label: Model release date
concepts.definition: Publication calendar date of a scientific model.

concepts.label: Coefficient data version
concepts.definition: Version of the installed coefficient dataset.

concepts.label: Spherical-harmonic degree
concepts.definition: Maximum spherical-harmonic degree represented by a model; a nonnegative integer, not an angle.

concepts.label: Spherical-harmonic order
concepts.definition: Maximum spherical-harmonic order represented by a model; a nonnegative integer.

concepts.label: Calculation runtime version
concepts.definition: Version of the calculation implementation used for reproducibility.

concepts.label: Reference ellipsoid
concepts.definition: Identifier of the ellipsoid used for geographic coordinates.

concepts.label: Includes centrifugal acceleration
concepts.definition: Boolean declaration that total gravity includes centrifugal acceleration.

concepts.label: Coefficient SHA-256
concepts.definition: Hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the installed coefficient file.

concepts.label: North component
concepts.definition: Signed vector component positive along the local north axis.

concepts.label: East component
concepts.definition: Signed vector component positive along the local east axis.

concepts.label: Down component
concepts.definition: Signed vector component positive downward along the local vertical.

concepts.label: Vector magnitude
concepts.definition: Nonnegative Euclidean norm of a vector.

concepts.label: Input positions
concepts.definition: Positions supplied as inputs to an operation.

concepts.label: Output samples
concepts.definition: Evaluated samples returned by an operation.

concepts.label: Model provenance role
concepts.definition: Scientific model information supporting a result.

concepts.label: WGS84 ellipsoid convention
concepts.definition: WGS84 geodetic latitude/longitude with Greenwich origin and ellipsoidal depth positive downward; not a fully specified terrestrial frame realization or epoch.

concepts.label: Local North-East-Down
concepts.definition: Local north, east and downward axes at the evaluation position on WGS84; downward is opposite ellipsoidal up.

concepts.label: Gravity evaluation result
concepts.definition: Evaluated total gravity acceleration vector and scalar total gravity potential at a position, using a declared gravity model.

concepts.label: Geodetic position
concepts.definition: Position specified by geodetic latitude, longitude and an ellipsoid-relative vertical coordinate with a declared representation.

concepts.label: File content digest
concepts.definition: A digest computed from the byte content of a file using a specified digest algorithm.
constraints: A digest is not a model version or proof of authenticity.
Compare digests only with compatible algorithms, input-byte scope and representations.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of digest hierarchy and file roles, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: SHA-256 file digest
concepts.definition: A 256-bit digest computed from the complete byte content of a file using SHA-256.
constraints: SHA-256 is the digest algorithm; the provider declares the encoding of its 256-bit output.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of digest hierarchy and file roles, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Coefficient file
concepts.definition: Identifies the source file of a digest as a scientific model coefficient file.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of digest hierarchy and file roles, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Model metadata file
concepts.definition: Identifies the source file of a digest as a scientific model metadata file.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of digest hierarchy and file roles, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Dip
concepts.definition: Angular departure of a specified geometric object from a declared horizontal plane, measured in a specified vertical section. The specialization supplies object type, section, sign and range. No universal sign/range is imposed here.

concepts.label: Magnetic dip
concepts.definition: Signed angle of a magnetic flux-density vector from its horizontal projection, positive toward the declared downward axis. Requires position, instant, model and local frame. Undefined for the zero vector.

concepts.label: Magnetic declination
concepts.definition: Signed horizontal angle from geodetic north to the magnetic vector's horizontal projection, positive east. Requires position, instant, model and frame. Undefined when the horizontal projection is zero.

concepts.label: Earth magnetic flux density
concepts.definition: Component or magnitude of Earth's magnetic flux-density vector. A component or magnitude role specifies which scalar is represented. Requires position, instant and geomagnetic model; components require a frame.

concepts.label: Geomagnetic vector
concepts.definition: Earth's magnetic flux-density vector at a position and instant, expressed in a declared frame and evaluated with a declared model.

concepts.label: Instant
concepts.definition: A position on a time axis identified using a declared time scale and representation. Neither elapsed duration nor a calendar date alone.

concepts.label: Geodetic evaluation point
concepts.definition: A geodetic position paired with an evaluation instant. HasPart position and instant; is not a subtype of position merely because its JSON flattens coordinates and timestamp.

concepts.label: Geomagnetic sample
concepts.definition: An evaluation point paired with a geomagnetic vector and derived magnitudes and orientation angles. HasPart evaluation point, vector, magnetic dip and declination; EvaluatedUsing geomagnetic model provenance. Derived undefined angles are optional values.

concepts.label: Geomagnetic evaluation request
concepts.definition: A request to evaluate a selected geomagnetic model at supplied evaluation points. Execution and batching policies belong to the provider.

concepts.label: Geomagnetic evaluation response
concepts.definition: Evaluated geomagnetic samples with the model provenance supporting them. Ordering belongs to the provider.

concepts.label: Scientific model provenance
concepts.definition: Identity and reproducibility information for a scientific model and the implementation/data used to evaluate it.

concepts.label: Geomagnetic model provenance
concepts.definition: Identity, applicability and reproducibility information for a geomagnetic reference model.

concepts.label: Model selection token
concepts.definition: Provider-defined token selecting an installed model; its value set and mapping to model identity belong to that provider.

concepts.label: Horizontal magnitude
concepts.definition: Nonnegative Euclidean norm of a vector's projection onto the declared horizontal plane. Requires the projection plane. Not equivalent to the full-vector magnitude role.

concepts.label: Lower bound
concepts.definition: Lower endpoint of a declared ordered domain or interval. The binding identifies the bounded domain and whether the endpoint is included.

concepts.label: Upper bound
concepts.definition: Upper endpoint of a declared ordered domain or interval. The binding identifies the bounded domain and whether the endpoint is included.

concepts.label: Input evaluation points
concepts.definition: Evaluation points supplied to an operation. Does not imply ordering, completeness or atomicity.

concepts.label: Coordinated Universal Time
concepts.definition: UTC time-scale reference for a timestamp. Accepted serialization and representable precision are provider concerns.

concepts.label: Geoid-referenced depth
concepts.definition: Depth coordinate positive downward from a specified model geoid; the negative of the corresponding geoid-referenced height.
constraints: Not interchangeable with a local tidal datum, instantaneous sea surface or unspecified mean sea level.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Geoid undulation
concepts.definition: Signed height of a specified model geoid relative to a specified reference ellipsoid at a horizontal position, positive when the geoid is above the ellipsoid.
constraints: A separation between reference surfaces, not a point depth coordinate.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Position with geoid-referenced depth
concepts.definition: Position represented by geodetic latitude and longitude with a depth relative to a specified model geoid.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Geoid model provenance
concepts.definition: Identity and reproducibility information for a geoid model, its sampled data and evaluation method.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Angular grid spacing
concepts.definition: Angular separation between adjacent grid nodes along a declared coordinate axis.
constraints: Angular spacing is not a spatial distance or a model accuracy.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Geoid representation error
concepts.definition: Magnitude statistic of errors from a sampled geoid representation and its interpolation relative to the reference geoid model.
constraints: Not the geoid model error relative to the real Earth, nor the uncertainty of an input depth.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Maximum absolute error
concepts.definition: Role identifying a reported maximum absolute error over the stated evaluation domain.
constraints: A reported estimate is not automatically a rigorous bound.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Root mean square error
concepts.definition: Role identifying the square root of the mean squared errors over the stated sample population.
constraints: RMS error is not generally a standard deviation.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Interpolation method
concepts.definition: Named method used to estimate values between sampled data points.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Dataset timestamp
concepts.definition: Role identifying an instant supplied as a timestamp of a dataset; the provider declares the event represented.
constraints: Do not infer publication, creation or evaluation time from an unspecified dataset timestamp.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Vertical datum conversion request
concepts.definition: Request to express supplied vertical coordinates relative to another declared vertical reference.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Vertical datum conversion response
concepts.definition: Converted vertical-coordinate samples with the model provenance used for their conversion.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Vertical datum conversion sample
concepts.definition: An input position paired with a converted vertical coordinate and the reference-surface separation used in the conversion.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: EGM84 model geoid
concepts.definition: The geoid represented by the EGM84 model, used by this provider as its mean-sea-level reference surface.
requiredContext: model data realization and evaluation method
constraints: Not a local tidal datum or instantaneous sea surface.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthVerticalDatum vocabulary with LengthStandard for geoid undulation, 2026-09-27; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Authority identifier
concepts.definition: Identifier consisting of an authority namespace and an object code, optionally qualified by registry version and URI.
constraints: A code alone is not globally unique. A provider UUID is not an authority code.

concepts.label: Catalogue entry provenance
concepts.definition: Source, source version and identity-matching evidence for a catalogue definition.
constraints: A matching status is not the semantic curation status. Source authority does not imply local executability.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthGeodesy decisions and new UnitConversion quantity bindings, 2026-09-28; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Ellipsoid axis length
concepts.definition: Length of a principal semi-axis of a reference ellipsoid.
constraints: A semi-axis length is not a radius at an arbitrary latitude.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthGeodesy decisions and new UnitConversion quantity bindings, 2026-09-28; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Semi-major axis
concepts.definition: Role identifying the equatorial semi-major axis a of an oblate ellipsoid of revolution.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthGeodesy decisions and new UnitConversion quantity bindings, 2026-09-28; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Semi-minor axis
concepts.definition: Role identifying the polar semi-minor axis b of an oblate ellipsoid of revolution.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthGeodesy decisions and new UnitConversion quantity bindings, 2026-09-28; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Inverse flattening
concepts.definition: Reciprocal of ellipsoidal flattening f=(a-b)/a for a non-spherical ellipsoid.
constraints: For a sphere f=0 and its reciprocal is not finite; a finite sentinel must be explicitly documented. EarthGeodesy uses zero as that sentinel.
Meaningful display precision is owned by the InverseFlattening quantity; it does not round stored values or establish ellipsoid accuracy.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthGeodesy decisions and new UnitConversion quantity bindings, 2026-09-28; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Reference ellipsoid definition
concepts.definition: Definition of an ellipsoid of revolution used as a geometric reference surface, including its dimensions and shape.
constraints: An ellipsoid definition is neither its identifier nor a geodetic reference frame.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthGeodesy decisions and new UnitConversion quantity bindings, 2026-09-28; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Prime meridian
concepts.definition: Meridian defining the origin from which geodetic longitudes are measured.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthGeodesy decisions and new UnitConversion quantity bindings, 2026-09-28; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Prime-meridian longitude
concepts.definition: Angular position of a selected prime meridian measured east from a declared comparison meridian.
constraints: EarthGeodesy expresses this offset east of Greenwich; position longitude is instead measured from the selected datum prime meridian.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthGeodesy decisions and new UnitConversion quantity bindings, 2026-09-28; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Geodetic reference object
concepts.definition: A terrestrial geodetic reference frame or datum ensemble used to reference coordinates.
constraints: An ellipsoid alone does not specify a reference frame.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthGeodesy decisions and new UnitConversion quantity bindings, 2026-09-28; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Geodetic reference frame
concepts.definition: Realization of a terrestrial reference system that establishes the origin, scale and orientation of coordinates.

concepts.label: Static geodetic reference frame
concepts.definition: Geodetic reference frame in which defining station coordinates are treated as invariant with time.

concepts.label: Dynamic geodetic reference frame

concepts.label: Geodetic datum ensemble
concepts.definition: Collection of reference-frame realizations considered equivalent for applications within a stated ensemble accuracy.

concepts.label: Datum ensemble accuracy
concepts.definition: Stated positional difference tolerance associated with treating ensemble members as equivalent.
constraints: Not an operation accuracy, observation uncertainty or guaranteed standard deviation.
evidence: Eric Cayeux approval of EarthGeodesy decisions and new UnitConversion quantity bindings, 2026-09-28; CURATION-DECISIONS.md

concepts.label: Coordinate reference system
concepts.definition: Coordinate system related to the Earth through a datum, reference frame or datum ensemble.

concepts.label: Coordinate operation domain
concepts.definition: Coordinate representation and dimensionality expected by an operation, such as geographic 2D, geographic 3D or geocentric 3D.

concepts.label: Geodetic epoch
concepts.definition: Time position at which a geodetic frame, coordinates or realization is defined or evaluated.

concepts.label: Coordinate epoch
concepts.definition: Epoch to which the coordinates of a position refer.

concepts.label: Realization epoch
concepts.definition: Epoch associated with realization of a geodetic reference frame as documented by the defining authority.

concepts.label: Geographic bounding box

concepts.definition: Projected coordinate positive in the declared grid-north direction, with CRS and origin explicit.

concepts.label: Geographic coordinate reference system
concepts.definition: CRS using ellipsoidal latitude/longitude and optionally a vertical coordinate; provider declares dimensionality.

concepts.label: Projected coordinate reference system
concepts.definition: CRS derived by map projection from a base geographic CRS, including conversion and Cartesian coordinate system.

concepts.label: Coordinate conversion
concepts.definition: Coordinate operation changing representation while retaining the underlying datum/frame.
constraints: The underlying datum or reference frame is retained.

concepts.label: Cartographic projection
concepts.definition: Conversion between ellipsoidal geographic coordinates and map-plane coordinates under a specified method and parameters.

concepts.label: Cartographic projection method
concepts.definition: Mathematical projection method, distinct from a configured conversion or projected CRS instance.

concepts.label: Cartographic projection parameter
concepts.definition: Method-defined projection parameter whose identity determines meaning, representation, range and quantity. No universal physical quantity.
constraints: Parameter identity and method must be resolved before assigning a physical quantity; a generic Value has no universal unit.
Normalized Value and OriginalValue may have different representations.

concepts.label: Projection parameter definition
concepts.definition: Specification of a parameter's identity, permitted representation, requiredness and bounds; distinct from an assigned value.

concepts.label: Coordinate system
concepts.definition: Axes and mathematical rules defining coordinate measurement and ordering, distinct from a CRS tied to a datum.

concepts.label: Projected coordinate system
concepts.definition: Cartesian coordinate system of a projected CRS, with explicit axis directions, order and units.

concepts.label: Coordinate system axis
concepts.definition: One axis with name, abbreviation, direction, unit and serialization order.

concepts.label: Coordinate axis direction
concepts.definition: Direction of an axis in its declared frame; an enum value is not an azimuth or a physical quantity. Polar axes require meridian/orientation context.

concepts.label: Linear unit conversion factor
concepts.definition: Multiplicative conversion coefficient between explicitly identified source/target linear units. UnitToMetre means metres per source unit, not map scale.
constraints: UnitToMetre denotes metres per explicitly identified source unit; it is not a projection scale factor.

concepts.label: Grid convergence
concepts.definition: Signed angular relation between geodetic north and grid north at a specified position in a specified projection; explicit sign convention required.
constraints: Unavailable is represented separately from zero.
Display precision does not establish convergence calculation accuracy.

concepts.label: Projection scale factor
concepts.definition: Full multiplicative scale factor at the method-defined origin/line/parallel; unity means no local scale change. Not Helmert's increment s or a universal pointwise distortion result.
constraints: Unity means no local scale change. This is a full factor, not a Helmert scale increment or a ppm value.
The factor applies at the method-defined location; it does not describe distortion at every point.
Meaningful precision is a display convention, not calculation accuracy or stored-value rounding.

concepts.label: Projection angular parameter
concepts.definition: Angular method parameter; parameter identity distinguishes latitude, longitude, azimuth, cone angle or grid rotation.

concepts.label: Projection linear parameter
concepts.definition: Linear method parameter, such as a false-origin offset or projection-plane height; not automatically a projected position.

concepts.label: Forward projection request
concepts.definition: Request to convert ordered geographic positions to projected positions using one definition.

concepts.label: Inverse projection request
concepts.definition: Request to convert ordered projected positions to geographic positions using one definition.

concepts.label: Projection result
concepts.definition: Projection evaluation result with definition/CRS identity, conventions, ordered corresponding positions and applicability. Shared by both directions.

concepts.label: Projection position result
concepts.definition: One corresponding geographic/projected pair with position index and nullable convergence. Input/output roles depend on direction.

concepts.label: Natural origin
concepts.definition: Method-defined natural origin; cannot be substituted for a false origin or projection centre.

concepts.label: False origin
concepts.definition: Method-defined false origin for assigned coordinate offsets.

concepts.label: Projection centre
concepts.definition: Method-defined projection centre.

concepts.label: Standard parallel
concepts.definition: Method-defined standard parallel; distinct from an arbitrary latitude or grid spacing.

concepts.label: First standard parallel
concepts.definition: First of the method's ordered standard parallels.

concepts.label: Second standard parallel
concepts.definition: Second of the method's ordered standard parallels.

concepts.label: Pseudo standard parallel
concepts.definition: Method-defined pseudo standard parallel; not asserted to be a true standard parallel.

concepts.label: Grid convergence true to grid clockwise

constraints: Positive clockwise from true/geodetic north to grid north.

concepts.label: Projected easting northing SI

concepts.definition: Zero along-hole depth is the intersection of the oriented wellbore path, or its defined extension, with the WGS84 ellipsoid. requiredContext: selected intersection when multiple intersections exist
constraints: Do not infer an intersection or extrapolation model from a scalar depth.
When the path/reference intersection cannot be established, reference conversion is unavailable.

evidence: SurveyInstrumentModelType Gyro variants; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Wolff-de Wård survey error model
concepts.definition: Wolff-de Wård formulation for propagating directional-survey uncertainty.
evidence: SurveyInstrumentModelType WolffDeWardt variants; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: ISCWSA position uncertainty model
concepts.definition: ISCWSA Revision 5 formulation for propagating directional-survey uncertainty from standardized error sources.
evidence: ISCWSA Definition of the Error Model Revision 5.13; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Survey error source
concepts.definition: A standardized contributor to directional-survey uncertainty, including its code, propagation and operating classifications, one-sigma magnitude and weighting behavior.

concepts.label: Survey error-source template
concepts.definition: Independently managed reusable template from which a survey instrument may take an error-source snapshot.
evidence: SurveyInstrument ErrorSource API and batch contract; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Embedded survey error-source snapshot
concepts.definition: Frozen error-source definition embedded in a survey instrument; later changes to a same-UUID template do not propagate into the snapshot.
evidence: SurveyInstrument ErrorSource snapshot contract; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Survey error-source code
concepts.definition: Exact finite ISCWSA or legacy survey-error identifier. The provider's closed enum tokens are preserved verbatim.

concepts.label: Survey error magnitude
concepts.definition: Nonnegative one-sigma standard uncertainty assigned to a survey error source.
constraints: The physical quantity is determined by the error-source definition.
This is not a signed correction or coordinate.
evidence: ErrorSource.Magnitude and ISCWSA sigma_i; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Error-magnitude quantity identifier
concepts.definition: Canonical UnitConversion physical-quantity name that determines the dimension and SI unit of a survey error magnitude.
constraints: The identifier must be compatible with the selected error-source code.

concepts.label: Survey error propagation mode
concepts.definition: ISCWSA correlation and propagation classification for a survey error source.
constraints: Random, Systematic, Global and Well-by-Well are distinct modes.
evidence: ISCWSA propagation framework; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Random propagation mode
concepts.definition: ISCWSA propagation mode for an error contribution treated as random according to the selected error model.

concepts.label: Systematic propagation mode
concepts.definition: ISCWSA propagation mode for an error contribution treated as systematic according to the selected error model.

concepts.label: Global propagation mode
concepts.definition: ISCWSA propagation mode fully correlated across all survey stations, all survey legs and all wells in the applicable project or field.
evidence: ErrorSource.IsGlobal and ISCWSA Global mode; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Well-by-Well propagation mode
concepts.definition: ISCWSA propagation mode whose correlation is shared within one well and independent between wells.
evidence: ISCWSA Well-by-Well mode; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Gyro operating mode
concepts.definition: Mutually exclusive operating state controlling how a gyroscopic survey instrument acquires observations and propagates errors.
constraints: The instrument operates in either Stationary or Continuous mode at a given point.
An error source may be applicable in Stationary mode, Continuous mode or both; applicability is not the operating state.
evidence: ISCWSA Definition of the Error Model Revision 5.13 section 7.2; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Stationary gyro mode
concepts.definition: Gyro operating mode in which the tool remains still at a survey station and weighting functions are evaluated statically at that position.
evidence: ISCWSA stationary gyro behavior; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Continuous gyro mode
concepts.definition: Gyro operating mode in which observations are recorded while moving and time/depth-dependent errors accumulate recursively from the previous survey station.
evidence: ISCWSA continuous gyro behavior; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Earth angular velocity
concepts.definition: Angular velocity of the Earth used by a gyroscopic survey error model.

concepts.label: Survey-instrument cant angle
concepts.definition: Rotation of the transverse axes of the orthogonal tool body frame about the along-hole tool axis.

concepts.label: Orthogonal body-frame cant convention
concepts.definition: Cant is measured in the orthogonal tool body frame about the along-hole z axis; the declared positive convention applies for tool inclination less than or equal to 90 degrees.

concepts.label: Survey-tool running speed
concepts.definition: Along-hole linear speed of a continuously recording survey tool.
evidence: SurveyInstrument.GyroRunningSpeed and CovarianceCalculatorISCWSA; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Gyro reinitialization distance
concepts.definition: Minimum accumulated along-hole distance between gyro initializations.
constraints: This is an interval extent, not a depth coordinate.
evidence: SurveyInstrument.GyroMinDist and CovarianceCalculatorISCWSA; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Gyro noise-reduction factor
concepts.definition: Dimensionless factor applied to selected stationary-gyro noise weighting functions.

concepts.label: Gyro K switching operator
concepts.definition: Dimensionless logical K operator used to switch the cant convention of transverse accelerometers across 90-degree inclination.
constraints: Permitted values are +1 and -1.
evidence: ISCWSA Definition of the Error Model Revision 5.13; SurveyInstrument.GyroSwitching; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Relative along-hole-depth standard uncertainty
concepts.definition: One-sigma uncertainty of along-hole depth expressed as a dimensionless proportion.

concepts.label: Instrument misalignment standard uncertainty
concepts.definition: One-sigma angular uncertainty due to survey-instrument misalignment.

concepts.label: True-inclination standard uncertainty
concepts.definition: One-sigma angular uncertainty assigned to the true-inclination term of a survey error model.

concepts.label: Survey-reference standard uncertainty
concepts.definition: One-sigma angular uncertainty assigned to the reference term of a survey error model.

concepts.label: Drill-string magnetic-interference standard uncertainty
concepts.definition: One-sigma uncertainty due to drill-string magnetic interference; its physical representation is determined by the selected legacy or current error-model term.
evidence: SurveyInstrument.DrillStringMag, AMID and AMIL; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Gyro-compass standard uncertainty
concepts.definition: One-sigma angular uncertainty of the gyro-compass term.

concepts.label: Along-hole-depth standard uncertainty
concepts.definition: One-sigma linear uncertainty of an along-hole-depth observation; it is origin-free and is not a depth coordinate.
evidence: ISCWSA DRFR, DRFS and XCL terms; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Acceleration standard uncertainty
concepts.definition: One-sigma uncertainty of an accelerometer or gravity-related error term.
evidence: ISCWSA accelerometer error terms; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Magnetic-flux-density standard uncertainty
concepts.definition: One-sigma uncertainty of a magnetic flux-density error term.
evidence: ISCWSA magnetometer error terms and AMIL; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Scale-factor standard uncertainty
concepts.definition: One-sigma dimensionless uncertainty of an instrument or depth scale factor.
evidence: ISCWSA scale-factor error terms; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Angular-velocity standard uncertainty
concepts.definition: One-sigma uncertainty of a gyro bias, noise or drift rate.
evidence: ISCWSA gyro bias, noise and drift terms; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Angular-random-walk standard uncertainty
concepts.definition: One-sigma angular random-walk coefficient used by a continuous gyro error model.
evidence: ISCWSA GXYZ_RW, GXY_RW and GZ_RW; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Reciprocal-length standard uncertainty
concepts.definition: One-sigma reciprocal-length coefficient used by a depth-stretch survey error term.

concepts.label: Angle-magnetic-flux-density standard uncertainty
concepts.definition: One-sigma angle-times-magnetic-flux-density coefficient which is divided by the applicable magnetic-field component by DBH weighting functions to produce an angular contribution.
evidence: ISCWSA DBH terms and ErrorSourceFactory weighting functions; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: AMID axial magnetic-interference standard uncertainty
concepts.definition: Legacy AMID representation of axial magnetic interference as a one-sigma planar angular uncertainty.
constraints: Do not interpret AMID as magnetic flux in webers.

concepts.label: AMIL axial magnetic-interference standard uncertainty
concepts.definition: Current AMIL representation of axial magnetic interference as a one-sigma magnetic-flux-density uncertainty.
evidence: AMIL replacement for AMID; Eric Cayeux clarification, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: Error applicability start
concepts.definition: Marks the inclusive lower inclination boundary at which a survey error source becomes applicable, subject to the selected implementation contract.

concepts.label: Error applicability end
concepts.definition: Marks the upper inclination boundary at which a survey error source ceases to be applicable; endpoint inclusion belongs to the selected implementation contract.

concepts.label: Error initialization inclination
concepts.definition: Marks the wellbore inclination used to initialize or reinitialize a survey error source.

concepts.label: Error applicability interval
concepts.definition: Inclination interval over which a survey error source applies, defined by explicit start and end boundary roles.
evidence: ErrorSource.UseInclinationInterval, StartInclination and EndInclination; Eric Cayeux approval, 2026-09-30

concepts.label: K-operator imposed
concepts.definition: Opaque legacy ISCWSA flag indicating that a K-operator treatment is imposed. No stronger mathematical behavior is asserted.

concepts.label: Weighting-function singularity risk
concepts.definition: Indicator that evaluation of a survey error source's weighting functions may encounter a singular condition.

concepts.label: Error-source ordering index
concepts.definition: Provider-owned implementation ordering value for a survey error source; it is not an ISCWSA semantic identity.
constraints: Do not use this index as the error-source identity.

concepts.label: Survey run
concepts.definition: Managed acquisition or planning run containing ordered directional survey measurements and the survey stations calculated from them for one wellbore.
evidence: Trajectory Model/SurveyRun.cs and SurveyRunController REST/MCP contracts; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Actual survey run
concepts.definition: Survey run representing observations or imported observations of a drilled wellbore.
evidence: Trajectory SurveyRunType.Actual REST/MCP enum; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Planned survey run
concepts.definition: Survey run representing directional stations intended for a planned wellbore path.
evidence: Trajectory SurveyRunType.Planned REST/MCP enum; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Survey measurement
concepts.definition: Directional observation at an along-hole depth, carrying inclination and azimuth together with acquisition, reference and correction provenance.
evidence: Trajectory Model/SurveyMeasurement.cs REST/MCP schema; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Survey station
concepts.definition: Calculated directional and Cartesian state of a wellbore path at a specified along-hole depth.
evidence: OSDC Drilling Surveying SurveyStation and Trajectory REST/MCP schemas; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Survey measurement origin
concepts.definition: Provenance classification stating whether a directional row is an instrument measurement or an already supplied terminal extrapolation.
constraints: Only the final row of a survey run may be extrapolated.
evidence: Trajectory SurveyMeasurementOrigin REST/MCP enum; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Measured survey measurement
concepts.definition: Survey measurement acquired as a physical directional observation.

concepts.label: Extrapolated survey measurement
concepts.definition: Already supplied terminal survey row representing an extrapolation beyond the last instrument measurement.
constraints: This origin may occur only on the final row of a survey run.

concepts.label: Survey inclination reference
concepts.definition: Reference direction from which wellbore inclination is measured.
evidence: Trajectory SurveyInclinationReference REST/MCP enum; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Geodetic vertical
concepts.definition: Inclination reference defined by the normal to the applicable geodetic reference ellipsoid.

concepts.label: Gravity vertical
concepts.definition: Inclination reference defined by the local gravity direction.

concepts.label: Survey azimuth reference
concepts.definition: North reference from which wellbore azimuth is measured clockwise.
evidence: Trajectory SurveyAzimuthReference REST/MCP enum; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: True north
concepts.definition: Azimuth reference directed toward geodetic north at the evaluation position.

concepts.label: Magnetic north
concepts.definition: Azimuth reference directed along the horizontal component of the local geomagnetic field.

concepts.label: Survey measurement correction
concepts.definition: Provenance record for inclination and azimuth corrections applied to an observed survey measurement, including model inputs and evaluation instant.
evidence: Trajectory SurveyMeasurementCorrection REST/MCP schema; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Applied inclination correction
concepts.definition: Signed angular correction added to observed inclination to obtain the corrected inclination.

concepts.label: Applied azimuth correction
concepts.definition: Signed angular correction added to observed azimuth to obtain the corrected azimuth.

concepts.label: Wellbore trajectory
concepts.definition: Managed ordered representation of a wellbore path assembled from one or more survey-run sections and calculated survey stations.
evidence: Trajectory Model/Trajectory.cs and TrajectoryController REST/MCP contracts; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Actual wellbore trajectory
concepts.definition: Wellbore trajectory representing a drilled path.
evidence: Trajectory TrajectoryType.Actual REST/MCP enum; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Planned wellbore trajectory
concepts.definition: Wellbore trajectory representing an intended path.
evidence: Trajectory TrajectoryType.Planned REST/MCP enum; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Definitive wellbore trajectory
concepts.definition: Trajectory designated as the authoritative current representation among trajectories of its applicable scope.
evidence: Trajectory.TrajectoryLight.IsDefinitive and search contracts; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Trajectory survey-run section
concepts.definition: Ordered contribution of a survey run to a trajectory beginning at an explicit along-hole abscissa.
evidence: TrajectorySurveyRunSection REST/MCP schema; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Trajectory calculation method
concepts.definition: Algorithm used to calculate continuous path geometry and derived survey stations from directional observations or section controls.
evidence: OSDC Surveying TrajectoryCalculationType REST/MCP enum; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Minimum-curvature trajectory method
concepts.definition: Survey calculation method joining consecutive directional observations by the conventional minimum-curvature circular arc.

concepts.label: True vertical depth
concepts.definition: Downward depth coordinate of a survey station along the selected vertical reference direction.
evidence: SurveyStation.TVD in Trajectory REST/MCP schemas; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Survey station position
concepts.definition: Position of a survey station represented by local north, east and true-vertical-depth coordinates with explicit references.
evidence: SurveyStation position fields in Trajectory REST/MCP schemas; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Wellbore curvature
concepts.definition: Magnitude of change of the wellbore tangent direction per unit along-hole length.
constraints: Curvature is nonnegative; signed directional components are build rate and turn rate.
evidence: SurveyStation.Curvature and Trajectory calculation REST/MCP schemas; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Build rate
concepts.definition: Signed rate of change of wellbore inclination per unit along-hole length.
evidence: SurveyStation.BUR and build-turn REST/MCP fields; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Turn rate
concepts.definition: Signed rate of change of wellbore azimuth per unit along-hole length in the constant-build-and-turn representation.
constraints: Turn rate is not the same as the azimuthal component of spatial curvature near vertical inclination.
evidence: SurveyStation.TUR and build-turn REST/MCP fields; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Toolface angle
concepts.definition: Rotation angle about the local wellbore tangent that orients the curvature direction in the normal plane.
constraints: Toolface is undefined for a zero-curvature direction and requires special treatment near vertical where the reference normal is singular.
evidence: SurveyStation.Toolface and curve-control REST/MCP fields; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Vertical-section distance
concepts.definition: Signed horizontal projection of a survey-station displacement onto a specified vertical-section azimuth.
evidence: SurveyStation.VerticalSection in Trajectory REST/MCP schema; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Interpolated trajectory
concepts.definition: Derived trajectory sampled from a source trajectory at requested depth intervals and additional engineering abscissae.
evidence: InterpolatedTrajectoryController REST/MCP contracts; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Trajectory interpolation interval
concepts.definition: Requested along-hole spacing between interpolated trajectory samples.
constraints: This is an interval extent, not a depth coordinate.
evidence: InterpolatedTrajectory.InterpolationStep and trajectory Web UI; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Maximum chord-arc distance
concepts.definition: Maximum permitted geometric deviation between a curved path segment and its chord during discretization or refinement.
constraints: This is a nonnegative approximation tolerance.
evidence: Trajectory interpolation and minimum-distance REST/MCP contracts; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Survey-station uncertainty ellipse
concepts.definition: Confidence-scaled positional uncertainty ellipse at a survey station, defined by semi-major axis, semi-minor axis and orientation in an explicitly stated plane.
evidence: SurveyStationEllipseCalculation REST/MCP contracts; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Horizontal survey uncertainty ellipse
concepts.definition: Survey-station uncertainty ellipse projected in the local horizontal north-east plane.

concepts.label: Vertical survey uncertainty ellipse
concepts.definition: Survey-station uncertainty ellipse represented in the applicable vertical section plane.

concepts.label: Perpendicular survey uncertainty ellipse
concepts.definition: Survey-station uncertainty ellipse in the plane perpendicular to the local wellbore tangent.

concepts.label: Confidence factor
concepts.definition: Dimensionless probability or coverage factor selected for an uncertainty-dependent calculation.
constraints: The admissible interval and statistical interpretation are defined by the consuming calculation.
evidence: Trajectory uncertainty, landing, octree and anti-collision REST/MCP contracts; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Calculation case
concepts.definition: Persisted managed resource that records a calculation specification and may expose lifecycle state, progress, diagnostics and server-derived results.
constraints: Callers supply the calculation specification; lifecycle facts and results are derived by the service unless a narrower contract explicitly states otherwise.
An immediate calculation need not expose polling or progress when it completes in the submission or replacement response.
A queued calculation should expose a lightweight status projection until it reaches a terminal state.
evidence: Trajectory calculation-case REST/MCP resources; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05
OSDC calculation-case REST/MCP patterns; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-06

concepts.label: Calculation state
concepts.definition: Finite lifecycle state of a persisted calculation when its execution is tracked, such as queued, running, completed or failed.
constraints: An immediate calculation may enter a terminal state during submission without exposing intermediate states.
evidence: Trajectory CalculationState REST/MCP enum; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05
OSDC calculation-case REST/MCP patterns; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-06

concepts.label: Calculation progress
concepts.definition: Optional server-reported completed fraction of a calculation whose execution is tracked.
constraints: Values range from zero to one and are informational rather than an optimistic-concurrency token.
A service need not expose progress for a calculation that completes in the submission or replacement response.
evidence: Trajectory calculation light REST/MCP objects; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05
OSDC calculation-case REST/MCP patterns; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-06

concepts.label: Trajectory aggregation case
concepts.definition: Calculation that approximates one or more detailed trajectories with a compact ordered set of drilling-curve sections within stated geometric tolerances.
evidence: TrajectoryAggregationCaseController REST/MCP contracts; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Aggregated trajectory section
concepts.definition: One ordered drilling-curve section in a compact trajectory approximation, with explicit start state and curve-specific controls.
evidence: TrajectoryAggregationSection REST/MCP schema; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Circular-arc trajectory section
concepts.definition: Trajectory section whose Cartesian path is a circular arc defined by constant curvature magnitude and an initial toolface whose local value evolves along the arc.
evidence: TrajectoryAggregationSectionType.CircularArc and Section library; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Constant-curvature-and-toolface section
concepts.definition: Trajectory section controlled by constant curvature magnitude and constant local toolface.
evidence: TrajectoryAggregationSectionType.ConstantCurvatureAndToolface and Section library; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Constant-build-and-turn section
concepts.definition: Trajectory section controlled by constant signed build rate and constant signed turn rate.
evidence: TrajectoryAggregationSectionType.ConstantBuildAndTurn and Section library; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Trajectory realization case
concepts.definition: Calculation that samples multiple stochastic wellbore trajectories from a reference trajectory and its position-uncertainty model.
evidence: TrajectoryRealizationCaseController REST/MCP contracts; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Trajectory realization
concepts.definition: One sampled wellbore path from a trajectory realization calculation.
evidence: TrajectoryRealizationCase.RealizationList and chunk REST/MCP contracts; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Trajectory extrapolation case
concepts.definition: Calculation extending a source trajectory according to one enforced extrapolation specification variant.
constraints: Exactly one mode-specific specification is selected.
evidence: TrajectoryExtrapolationCaseController REST/MCP discriminated contract; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Fixed-length trajectory extrapolation
concepts.definition: Extrapolation continuing the terminal source geometry for a specified along-hole length using the selected continuation rule.
evidence: FixedLengthExtrapolationSpecification REST/MCP variant; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Reconnect-to-trajectory extrapolation
concepts.definition: Extrapolation solving a steering path from the source trajectory to a point advanced from the closest point on a reference trajectory.

concepts.label: Geosteering trajectory extrapolation
concepts.definition: Extrapolation solving a steering path to a target attitude and vertical depth under a departure-distance or drilled-length extent constraint.

concepts.label: Section-defined well-path extrapolation
concepts.definition: Extrapolation constructed from an ordered list of explicitly constrained drilling-curve sections.
evidence: WellPathExtrapolationSpecification REST/MCP variant; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Lead-in length
concepts.definition: Straight or source-geometry continuation length before active steering begins.
constraints: This is an along-hole extent, not a depth coordinate.
evidence: Trajectory extrapolation and target-landing LeadInLength/LeadLength fields; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Reference-trajectory advance
concepts.definition: Along-hole distance advanced on the reference trajectory from its closest point to define the reconnect target.
constraints: This is a signed or nonnegative interval according to the consuming operation, not an absolute depth coordinate.
evidence: Reconnect ReferenceMDAdvance and directional-control correction length; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Departure distance
concepts.definition: Horizontal displacement magnitude from an explicitly stated origin used as a geosteering extent constraint.
evidence: DepartureGeosteeringExtentConstraint REST/MCP schema; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Departure bearing
concepts.definition: Clockwise azimuth of horizontal departure relative to its declared north reference.

concepts.label: Solved trajectory section
concepts.definition: Server-derived section geometry and controls satisfying an extrapolation or landing constraint.
evidence: TrajectoryExtrapolationSolvedSection REST/MCP schema; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Target landing case
concepts.definition: Calculation of the subset of a planar target polygon reachable from a source trajectory under selected curve, attitude, uncertainty and maximum-curvature constraints.
evidence: TargetLandingCaseController REST/MCP contracts; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Target plane
concepts.definition: Oriented plane in local drilling space defined by an origin and forward normal, within which target polygons are expressed.
evidence: TargetPlaneDefinition and CurvilinearPoint3D REST/MCP schema; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Target boundary
concepts.definition: Ordered closed delineation in target-plane coordinates.
constraints: The quantity applies to each planar coordinate; the boundary itself is not a scalar length.
evidence: TargetPlanePoint polygon and target-landing REST/MCP schema; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Geological target boundary
concepts.definition: Target-plane boundary supplied as the geological region of interest before drilling-operational inset or reachability constraints.

concepts.label: Driller target boundary
concepts.definition: Operational target-plane boundary after applying the selected target type and uncertainty treatment.

concepts.label: Reachable target boundary
concepts.definition: Boundary of target-plane positions for which at least one valid landing solution satisfies the selected geometric, attitude, curvature and uncertainty constraints.
constraints: Multiple disjoint contours and interior holes are permitted when produced by the solution topology.
evidence: TargetLandingCase reachable contours REST/MCP schema and calculator; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Landing attitude mode
concepts.definition: Constraint selecting whether final landing attitude is free or perpendicular to the target plane.
evidence: TargetLandingAttitudeMode REST/MCP enum; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Free landing attitude
concepts.definition: Landing-attitude mode that does not constrain the final tangent to the target-plane normal.

concepts.label: Perpendicular-to-plane landing attitude
concepts.definition: Landing-attitude mode requiring the final wellbore tangent to align with the oriented target-plane normal.

concepts.label: Maximum landing curvature
concepts.definition: Maximum permitted peak wellbore curvature anywhere along a candidate landing path.
constraints: A candidate is feasible only when its curve-specific peak curvature does not exceed this limit.

concepts.label: Landing control point
concepts.definition: Sample of exact curve-specific steering controls along normalized length of a solved target-landing path.
evidence: TargetLandingControlPoint REST/MCP schema; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Directional control evaluation case
concepts.definition: Calculation comparing controls expected from repeated reconnect-to-reference solutions with controls fitted over corresponding intervals of an actual trajectory.
constraints: Reference and actual trajectories belong to the same wellbore.
evidence: DirectionalControlEvaluationCaseController REST/MCP contracts; Eric Cayeux requirements, 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Directional control evaluation sample
concepts.definition: Evaluation interval containing expected, actual and residual first-section steering controls at an actual-trajectory depth range.
evidence: DirectionalControlEvaluationSample REST/MCP schema; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Directional control residual
concepts.definition: Signed actual-minus-expected steering-control value over one directional-control evaluation interval.
evidence: DirectionalControlEvaluationSample residual fields; Eric Cayeux terminology, 2026-10-03

concepts.label: Curvature residual
concepts.definition: Actual-minus-expected curvature residual for a circular-arc or constant-curvature-and-toolface correction.

concepts.label: Toolface residual
concepts.definition: Circular actual-minus-expected toolface residual for a circular-arc or constant-curvature-and-toolface correction.
constraints: Statistics use circular angle handling rather than ordinary linear subtraction across the wrap boundary.

concepts.label: Build-rate residual
concepts.definition: Actual-minus-expected build-rate residual for a constant-build-and-turn correction.

concepts.label: Turn-rate residual
concepts.definition: Actual-minus-expected turn-rate residual for a constant-build-and-turn correction.

concepts.label: Directional control bundle
concepts.definition: Contiguous actual-depth range whose linked pair of steering-control residuals is represented by one statistically coherent response-bias family.
constraints: Individual failed evaluations do not break a bundle unless the hard invalid-gap limit is exceeded.
evidence: DirectionalControlBundling and DirectionalControlEvaluationBundle REST/MCP schema; Eric Cayeux requirements, 2026-10-03

concepts.label: Residual distribution summary
concepts.definition: Empirical distribution summary for one residual component, including P10, P50, P90, mean, standard deviation, median absolute deviation and histogram bins.
evidence: DirectionalControlDistributionSummary REST/MCP schema; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Well-path minimum-distance calculation
concepts.definition: Calculation of closest approaches between a reference survey run or trajectory and selected comparison paths, optionally accounting for borehole radii and adaptive refinement.
evidence: SurveyRun and Trajectory MinimumDistanceCalculation REST/MCP contracts; Eric Cayeux request, 2026-10-05

concepts.label: Center-to-center well-path distance
concepts.definition: Euclidean distance between the centerlines of two well paths at a closest-approach pair.
constraints: This is a nonnegative separation extent, not a position coordinate.

concepts.label: Borehole clearance distance
concepts.definition: Wall-to-wall separation equal to centerline distance minus the applicable borehole radii.
