constraints: Ordering, completeness, continuation and finalization are declared by the provider contract.
evidence: OSDC paged catalogue and chunked-result patterns; cross-domain generalization request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Page retrieval
concepts.definition: Read operation role that retrieves one bounded page of an ordered logical collection.
constraints: A page is not evidence that the logical collection is complete unless the response declares completion.
evidence: OSDC paged collection MCP patterns; cross-domain generalization request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Chunk retrieval
concepts.definition: Read operation role that retrieves one stable bounded chunk of a larger logical value or result.
constraints: Chunk identity, ordering and completeness are declared by the provider contract.
evidence: OSDC chunked calculation-result MCP patterns; cross-domain generalization request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Calculation queued state
concepts.definition: Calculation lifecycle state in which execution has been accepted or scheduled but has not begun running.
evidence: OSDC asynchronous calculation lifecycle generalization request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Calculation running state
concepts.definition: Calculation lifecycle state in which evaluation is actively executing and no terminal outcome has been reached.
evidence: OSDC asynchronous calculation lifecycle generalization request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Calculation completed state
concepts.definition: Terminal calculation lifecycle state in which evaluation succeeded and its contractually declared result is available.
constraints: A completed state must identify how the result is obtained when it is not embedded.
evidence: OSDC asynchronous calculation lifecycle generalization request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Calculation failed state
concepts.definition: Terminal calculation lifecycle state in which evaluation did not produce a successful result.
constraints: Machine-readable state is distinct from diagnostic text and retry policy.
evidence: OSDC asynchronous calculation lifecycle generalization request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Calculation cancelled state
concepts.definition: Terminal calculation lifecycle state confirming that requested execution cancellation has taken effect.
constraints: Cancellation does not imply deletion of the calculation case or its retained partial data.
evidence: OSDC asynchronous calculation lifecycle generalization request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Collection page
concepts.definition: Bounded ordered projection of part of a larger logical collection, carrying enough continuation or completion information for deterministic enumeration.
constraints: A page is not the complete collection unless completion is explicitly established.
evidence: OSDC paged collection MCP patterns; cross-domain generalization request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Collection item
concepts.definition: Role played by one member value in a collection page or bounded collection response.
evidence: OSDC paged collection MCP patterns; cross-domain generalization request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Continuation token
concepts.definition: Opaque provider-issued value used to request the next partition of the same logical enumeration.
constraints: Consumers must not infer ordering, offsets or authority from the token representation.
evidence: OSDC paged collection MCP patterns; cross-domain generalization request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Execution provenance
concepts.definition: Structured evidence describing the operation invocations that contributed to a produced answer, result or derived value.
constraints: Provenance records what was invoked; it does not by itself prove numerical correctness or authorize disclosure of inputs and outputs.
Sensitive arguments and responses remain subject to access and retention policy.
evidence: Request to explain which tools produced a DrillWeaver answer, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Operation invocation
concepts.definition: One recorded attempt to invoke a semantically identified provider operation as part of an execution.
constraints: Retries are distinct invocation attempts and retain their order.
A planned but undispatched operation is not an invocation.
evidence: Generic execution provenance request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Tool invocation
concepts.definition: Operation invocation dispatched through an identified callable tool contract, including MCP tools.
constraints: Tool display names are not semantic operation identities and may change independently.
evidence: Request to explain which MCP tools produced a DrillWeaver answer, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Operation provider
concepts.definition: Role played by the authority or service that exposes an invoked operation.
evidence: Generic execution provenance request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Invoked operation identifier
concepts.definition: Role played by a stable provider-scoped identifier of the operation or callable tool that was invoked.
constraints: This identifies the callable contract and is distinct from its semantic operation role.
evidence: Generic execution provenance request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Operation contract revision
concepts.definition: Role played by an immutable version, fingerprint or digest that identifies the exact callable contract used for an invocation.
constraints: A mutable endpoint address or display name is not an adequate contract revision.
evidence: Generated MCP terminal fingerprinting and generic provenance request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Invocation sequence
concepts.definition: Role played by the deterministic ordinal of an invocation attempt within one execution trace.
constraints: The ordinal establishes trace order and does not imply causal sufficiency by itself.
evidence: Generic execution provenance request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Invocation outcome
concepts.definition: Role played by the machine-readable success, failure, timeout, cancellation or indeterminate outcome of one invocation attempt.
constraints: Outcome is distinct from provider diagnostic text and from the lifecycle state of a calculation case.
evidence: Generic execution provenance request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Result contribution
concepts.definition: Role indicating that an invocation supplied evidence or a value used in a particular derived result or answer.
constraints: Invocations that were attempted but did not contribute remain in the execution trace and are not labelled as result contributions.
evidence: Request to explain which tools produced a DrillWeaver answer, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Invocation started at
concepts.definition: Role played by the recorded instant at which an invocation attempt was dispatched.
evidence: Generic execution provenance request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Invocation completed at
concepts.definition: Role played by the recorded instant at which an invocation attempt reached its recorded outcome.
evidence: Generic execution provenance request, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-09

concepts.label: Borehole diameter at abscissa evaluation
concepts.definition: Stateless evaluation that selects the outermost applicable borehole interval of a declared wellbore architecture at a supplied along-hole abscissa and returns its borehole diameter together with interval and source provenance.
constraints: All applicable casing and open-hole intervals are considered.
Missing or invalid interval geometry must not yield a guessed diameter.
The selected diameter and contributing architecture components remain traceable.
evidence: Request for an architecture evaluator supplying borehole size to uncertainty-envelope composition, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Borehole diameter at abscissa result
concepts.definition: Result identifying the outermost applicable borehole diameter at one along-hole abscissa and the architecture interval or intervals from which it was selected.
evidence: Request for an architecture evaluator supplying borehole size to uncertainty-envelope composition, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Projected borehole cross-section
concepts.definition: Ellipse obtained by orthogonally projecting the circular cross-section normal to the local wellbore tangent into a declared horizontal, vertical-section or tangent-perpendicular plane.
constraints: The result represents an orthogonal projection, not a planar intersection with the borehole cylinder.
A vertical-section projection also requires the vertical-section azimuth.
In the tangent-perpendicular plane the projection is circular.
evidence: Borehole-aware uncertainty projection design, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Uncertainty projection plane
concepts.definition: Selector identifying whether a survey-position uncertainty representation uses the local horizontal north-east plane, the declared vertical-section plane, or the plane perpendicular to the local wellbore tangent.
constraints: The value must be one of Horizontal, Vertical or Perpendicular and the associated axis convention remains explicitly declared.
evidence: Generic composition of projected borehole and uncertainty ellipses, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Interval start coordinate
concepts.definition: Role played by the inclusive start coordinate of a spatial or curvilinear interval in the coordinate concept and reference declared by the value.
constraints: This role does not itself select a coordinate kind, datum or unit and is distinct from a temporal validity start.
evidence: Borehole diameter-at-abscissa result contract, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Interval end coordinate
concepts.definition: Role played by the exclusive end coordinate of a spatial or curvilinear half-open interval in the coordinate concept and reference declared by the value.
constraints: This role does not itself select a coordinate kind, datum or unit and is distinct from a temporal validity end.
evidence: Borehole diameter-at-abscissa result contract, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Minimum-determinant ellipsoidal outer-bound convention
concepts.definition: Reference convention selecting the minimum-determinant member of the one-parameter ellipsoidal outer-bound family Q(beta)=(1+1/beta)Q1+(1+beta)Q2, beta greater than zero, for the Minkowski sum of two centred ellipses.
constraints: This convention provides a conservative enclosing ellipse within the declared family; it does not claim that the exact Minkowski sum is an ellipse or that the result is a globally minimum-area enclosing ellipse.
evidence: Borehole-aware uncertainty projection design, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Circular uncertainty-envelope dilation
concepts.definition: Stateless geometric evaluation that projects a circular physical cross-section into a declared plane and combines that projected ellipse with a planar positional-uncertainty ellipse using a declared conservative ellipsoidal outer-bound convention.
constraints: This is deterministic geometric envelope composition, not a confidence transformation or ordinary addition of unrelated lengths.
The exact Minkowski sum of rotated ellipses is generally not an ellipse.
The source uncertainty result, projected physical cross-section and approximation convention remain separately traceable.
evidence: Request to add borehole size to retained survey-position uncertainty dimensions, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Circularly dilated uncertainty envelope
concepts.definition: Conservative planar elliptical envelope of the Minkowski sum of a positional-uncertainty ellipse and the projected circular physical cross-section at the same station.
constraints: The result does not change the statistical confidence meaning of the source uncertainty ellipse.
The result must disclose the applied physical-envelope diameter and approximation convention.
Its axes and orientation may differ from the source ellipse.
evidence: Request to add borehole size to retained survey-position uncertainty dimensions, Eric Cayeux, 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Radial profile at abscissa evaluation
concepts.definition: Stateless evaluation that derives every known radial construction boundary of a declared wellbore architecture at one supplied along-hole abscissa and orders the boundaries from outermost to innermost.
constraints: Only provider-declared geometry may produce a boundary.
Coincident boundaries with distinct construction meanings remain separate result entries.
Every boundary retains its source component and applicable interval.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Wellbore radial profile
concepts.definition: Ordered result describing every known radial construction boundary at one along-hole abscissa, the materials adjacent to each boundary, and source-component provenance.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Radial boundary
concepts.definition: One circular construction boundary in a wellbore radial profile, retaining its physical denomination, diameter, adjacent material kinds and source provenance.
constraints: A boundary denomination does not assert that all surrounding construction layers are known.
Coincident boundaries may occur more than once when they have distinct construction meanings.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Radial boundary diameter
concepts.definition: Diameter of a circular boundary in a wellbore radial construction profile.
constraints: No reference-origin offset applies.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Radial boundary kind
concepts.definition: Finite denomination of the physical construction meaning represented by a radial-profile boundary.
constraints: The kind identifies a boundary meaning and is distinct from the material on either side.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Borehole wall boundary
concepts.definition: Radial boundary at the interface between the drilled borehole and the surrounding formation.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Cement outer boundary
concepts.definition: Outer radial boundary of a known cement annulus.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Cement inner boundary
concepts.definition: Inner radial boundary of a known cement annulus.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Casing outer boundary
concepts.definition: Outer radial boundary of a casing body or collar at the evaluated abscissa.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Casing inner boundary
concepts.definition: Inner radial boundary of a casing body at the evaluated abscissa.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Radial material kind
concepts.definition: Finite material or occupancy classification immediately adjacent to a radial construction boundary.
constraints: Unknown means not represented by available architecture data and must not be replaced by an inferred material.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Formation material
concepts.definition: Formation or surrounding geological material adjacent to a wellbore construction boundary.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Cement material
concepts.definition: Set cement occupying a declared annular construction interval.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Casing material
concepts.definition: Solid casing material between a declared casing outer and inner boundary.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Internal fluid or void material
concepts.definition: Fluid-filled, gas-filled or otherwise unclassified internal space inside the innermost known solid boundary.
constraints: This concept does not identify a particular fluid composition.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Unknown radial material
concepts.definition: Material adjacent to a radial boundary that is not established by the available architecture data.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Outermost known boundary
concepts.definition: Role selecting the first and largest known diameter in an outer-to-inner radial profile.
constraints: Known is explicit: missing outer construction data is not treated as zero thickness.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Innermost known boundary
concepts.definition: Role selecting the last and smallest known diameter in an outer-to-inner radial profile.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Material outside boundary
concepts.definition: Role played by the material or occupancy immediately outside a radial boundary.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Material inside boundary
concepts.definition: Role played by the material or occupancy immediately inside a radial boundary.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Outermost known physical envelope diameter
concepts.definition: Largest known applicable radial-boundary diameter at the evaluated abscissa, selected for external physical-clearance or projected-envelope calculations.
requiredContext: complete set of known applicable radial boundaries
constraints: The value is the largest known boundary in the supplied architecture data and does not assert that missing outer geometry is zero.
The selected source boundary remains traceable.
evidence: Ordered radial-profile evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Innermost known physical envelope diameter
concepts.definition: Smallest known applicable radial-boundary diameter at the evaluated abscissa, selected for internal-clearance calculations.
requiredContext: complete set of known applicable radial boundaries
constraints: The value is the smallest known boundary in the supplied architecture data and does not assert that missing inner geometry is zero.
The selected source boundary remains traceable.
evidence: Symmetric radial-profile extrema approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Deepest casing shoe evaluation
concepts.definition: Stateless evaluation that selects the deepest valid casing shoe in a wellbore architecture and returns its along-hole abscissa and ordered radial profile.
constraints: The shoe is the greatest finite casing-section bottom obtained from declared section top and length.
Invalid or incomplete section geometry is ignored and never guessed.
The returned radial profile is evaluated at the selected shoe with boundary handling declared by the provider.
evidence: Deepest casing shoe evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Deepest casing shoe result
concepts.definition: Result containing the deepest known casing shoe along-hole abscissa and the ordered wellbore radial profile at that position.
evidence: Deepest casing shoe evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10

concepts.label: Casing shoe along-hole depth
concepts.definition: Along-hole abscissa of the bottom boundary of a casing section.
evidence: Deepest casing shoe evaluator approved by Eric Cayeux on 2026-10-10
